ar.title: اكتب AI Song Release Identity Brief قبل رفع الاغنية
ar.description: Workflow عملي لفصل artist identity عن AI credits وlyrics وvisuals وdistributor notes قبل نشر اغنية AI-assisted.
body: الاغنية جاهزة تقريبا. لديك master، صورة غلاف، اسم مشروع يعجبك، وربما video قصير. ثم تظهر الاسئلة الصعبة في upload form: من هو artist؟ هل الصورة تمثل شخصا حقيقيا؟ اي جزء استخدم AI؟ هل الصوت يشبه فنانا معروفا؟ اذا انتظرت حتى يوم الرفع، ستكتب اجابات سريعة قد تجعل release يبدو اقل وضوحا من الاغنية نفسها.
## ما هي EasyMusic.AI؟

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ar/ai-music-generator) منصة لصناعة music drafts من text prompts وlyrics وstyle direction. اذا احتجت كلمات اولية او تعديلات على chorus، يساعد [AI Lyrics Generator](https://easymusic.ai/ar/tools/ai-lyrics-generator) على تحويل الفكرة الى lyric draft، ويمكن ان يساعد [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/ar/tools/music-style-generator) على وصف genre وmood وinstruments بدقة. هذه الادوات تساعدك على صناعة المسودة، لكن identity، الحقوق، distributor fields، وplatform disclosure تبقى قرارات منفصلة.
## افصل ثلاث هويات مختلفة

اكتب ثلاث جمل قبل النشر. الاولى: من هو الشخص او الفريق المسؤول عن release؟ الثانية: ما اسم artist project الذي سيظهر للناس؟ الثالثة: هل الprofile يقدم شخصا حقيقيا، stage name، fictional project، ام AI persona بصور تبدو واقعية؟ هذه ليست لعبة كلمات. بعض المنصات تفرق الان بين AI contribution داخل الtrack وبين public artist identity. استخدام AI في music لا يعني تلقائيا ان artist persona مصنوع بالذكاء الاصطناعي، والعكس صحيح.
## ارسم خريطة المساهمة بدل كلمة AI عامة

لا تكتب فقط AI used. اصنع role map قصيرة: lyrics, vocals, instrumental, production, cover art, video, captions. امام كل role اكتب human, AI-assisted, generated, edited, licensed, او not used. اذا كنت لا تعرف كيف سيعرض distributor هذه المعلومات، احتفظ بالخريطة كملف داخلي. عندما تظهر خانة credits او disclosure، ستجيب من سجل واضح لا من ذاكرة مرتبكة.
## لا تستعير هوية شخص اخر

قبل الupload، افحص prompt والlyrics والartist name والcover. احذف اي اسم فنان معروف، صوت قابل للتعرف عليه، look-alike portrait، logo قريب، او bio يوحي بعلاقة غير موجودة. حتى اذا كان الصوت جميلا، لا تجعل release يعتمد على confusion. اذا استخدمت vocal reference مرخصا او collaborator، احتفظ بالموافقة مكتوبة بجانب ملف الrelease.
## اكتب brief من صفحة واحدة

استخدم headings بسيطة: public artist name، profile type، visual source، song role map، input permissions، final files، distributor questions، public note. تحت public note اكتب جملة بشرية، لا دفاع قانوني: مثلا هذا track يستخدم AI-assisted instrumentation مع lyrics راجعها الكاتب. غرض الجملة هو الوضوح، لا تلميع القصة. داخل EasyMusic.AI، احفظ prompt النهائي واسم النسخة التي خرجت منها الملفات، ثم لا تخلطها مع اسم artist العام.
## افكار قابلة للاستخدام اليوم

- اختر profile type قبل طلب cover art.
- اكتب real person, stage name, fictional project, او AI persona في سجل داخلي.
- احفظ final prompt، lyric draft، وسبب رفض النسخ التي بدت قريبة من فنان معروف.
- اقرأ الbio على هاتف صغير كأنك listener لا يعرفك.
- افصل AI contribution notes عن artist biography.
- لا تنشر مجموعة كبيرة من tracks فقط لان توليدها كان سهلا.
## مراجعة قبل الرفع

اسأل: هل يستطيع listener فهم من يقف وراء project؟ هل اي visual يدعي وجود شخص حقيقي غير موجود؟ هل credits تقول اين ساعد AI بدقة معقولة؟ هل كل sample او lyric او vocal input مسموح استخدامه؟ هل الrelease يخالف قواعد platform حول impersonation او bulk uploads؟ اذا بقي جواب مهم غير معروف، اجل الupload. التأخير القصير افضل من correction عام بعد النشر.

## FAQ
### هل استخدام AI لصناعة الاغنية يعني انني AI persona؟
لا. AI persona عادة يتعلق بالهوية العامة التي تعرضها، خصوصا اذا بدت كشخص واقعي غير موجود. مساهمة AI في lyrics او vocals او instruments سؤال مختلف.
### هل يجب الافصاح في كل منصة؟
القواعد تختلف. احتفظ بسجل صادق، ثم اتبع اسئلة الupload الحالية في كل distributor او platform.
### هل يمكنني استخدام fictional artist؟
نعم، لكن لا تقدمه كشخص حقيقي بطريقة تخدع listener او تشبه فنانا معروفا.
### ماذا افعل اذا لا اعرف وضع الحقوق؟
لا تضع cleared في الملاحظات. اجمع permissions، راجع terms، واحصل على نصيحة مناسبة قبل نشر استخدام تجاري او واسع.

de.title: Schreibe ein AI Song Release Identity Brief vor dem Upload
de.description: Ein praktischer Workflow, der Artist Identity, AI Credits, Lyrics, Visuals und Distributor-Notizen vor einem AI-assisted Release trennt.
body: Der Song ist fast fertig. Es gibt einen Master, ein Cover, einen Projektnamen, vielleicht schon ein kurzes Video. Dann fragt das Upload-Formular ploetzlich: Wer ist der Artist? Zeigt das Bild eine echte Person? Welche Teile wurden mit AI erstellt? Klingt die Stimme wie jemand Bekanntes? Wenn du diese Fragen erst am Release-Tag beantwortest, wirkt die Veroeffentlichung schneller unklar als der Song.
## Was ist EasyMusic.AI?

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/de/ai-music-generator) ist eine Plattform, mit der du Musikentwuerfe aus Textprompts, Lyrics und Style Direction erstellen kannst. Fuer erste Lyrics oder Chorus-Varianten hilft der [AI Lyrics Generator](https://easymusic.ai/de/tools/ai-lyrics-generator), und der [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/de/tools/music-style-generator) macht Genre, Mood und Instrumente konkreter. Diese Tools helfen beim Entwurf; Identity, Rechte, Distributor-Felder und Plattform-Disclosure bleiben eigene Entscheidungen.
## Trenne drei verschiedene Identitaeten

Schreibe vor dem Upload drei Saetze. Erstens: Welche Person oder welches Team ist fuer den Release verantwortlich? Zweitens: Welcher Artist-Name erscheint oeffentlich? Drittens: Stellt das Profil eine reale Person, einen Stage Name, ein fiktionales Projekt oder eine AI Persona mit realistisch wirkenden Bildern dar? Das ist keine Wortklauberei. Einige Plattformen trennen inzwischen AI contribution im Track von der public artist identity. AI im Song macht ein Profil nicht automatisch zur AI Persona.
## Erstelle eine Rollenkarte statt eines AI-Sammelworts

Schreibe nicht nur AI used. Baue eine kurze Role Map: lyrics, vocals, instrumental, production, cover art, video, captions. Neben jede Rolle kommt human, AI-assisted, generated, edited, licensed oder not used. Wenn du noch nicht weisst, wie dein Distributor diese Angaben abfragt, bleibt die Map als interne Datei. Wenn spaeter Credits oder Disclosure-Felder auftauchen, antwortest du aus einem klaren Record.
## Leihe dir keine fremde Identitaet

Pruefe Prompt, Lyrics, Artist Name und Cover vor dem Upload. Entferne bekannte Artist-Namen, erkennbare Stimmen, Look-alike Portraits, aehnliche Logos oder Bios, die eine nicht vorhandene Verbindung andeuten. Auch ein guter Take sollte nicht auf Verwechslung beruhen. Wenn ein lizenzierter Vocal Reference oder Collaborator beteiligt ist, speichere die Zustimmung im Release-Ordner.
## Schreibe ein Brief auf einer Seite

Nutze einfache Ueberschriften: public artist name, profile type, visual source, song role map, input permissions, final files, distributor questions, public note. Die public note darf menschlich klingen, nicht wie eine Verteidigung: etwa dieser Track nutzt AI-assisted instrumentation und vom Autor ueberarbeitete Lyrics. Ziel ist Klarheit. In EasyMusic.AI speicherst du den finalen Prompt und die Version, aus der die Dateien kamen, aber du verwechselst sie nicht mit dem oeffentlichen Artist-Namen.
## Sofort nutzbare Ideen

- Entscheide den profile type, bevor du Cover Art bestellst.
- Schreibe real person, stage name, fictional project oder AI persona in einen internen Record.
- Speichere final prompt, lyric draft und Gruende, warum zu aehnliche Takes abgelehnt wurden.
- Lies die Bio auf einem kleinen Handybildschirm wie ein fremder Listener.
- Trenne AI contribution notes von der Artist Biography.
- Lade keine grosse Menge Tracks hoch, nur weil die Generierung leicht war.
## Review vor dem Upload

Frage: Versteht ein Listener, wer hinter dem Projekt steht? Behauptet ein Visual eine echte Person, die es nicht gibt? Sagen die Credits einigermassen genau, wo AI geholfen hat? Sind Samples, Lyrics und Vocal Inputs nutzbar? Koennte der Release gegen Regeln zu Impersonation oder Bulk Uploads verstossen? Wenn eine wichtige Antwort fehlt, verschiebe den Upload. Eine kurze Pause ist besser als eine oeffentliche Korrektur.

## FAQ
### Bedeutet AI im Song automatisch AI Persona?
Nein. AI Persona beschreibt meist die oeffentliche Identitaet, besonders wenn sie wie eine reale, nicht existierende Person wirkt. AI-Beitraege in Lyrics, Vocals oder Instrumenten sind ein anderes Feld.
### Muss ich AI ueberall offenlegen?
Regeln unterscheiden sich. Fuehre ehrliche Notizen und beantworte die aktuellen Upload-Fragen deines Distributors oder deiner Plattform.
### Darf ich einen fiktionalen Artist nutzen?
Ja, solange er keine echte Person vortaeuscht und nicht mit einem bekannten Artist verwechselt werden soll.
### Was, wenn Rechte unklar sind?
Schreibe nicht cleared. Sammle Permissions, pruefe Terms und hole passende Beratung ein, bevor du breit oder kommerziell veroeffentlichst.

en.title: Write an AI Song Release Identity Brief Before You Upload
en.description: A practical workflow for separating artist identity, AI credits, lyrics, visuals, and distributor notes before an AI-assisted release.
body: The song is almost ready. You have the master, a cover image, a project name you like, and maybe a short video. Then the upload form asks the awkward questions: who is the artist, does the image represent a real person, which parts used AI, and could the voice be mistaken for somebody else? If you wait until upload day, you may write rushed answers that make the release feel less clear than the song.
## What is EasyMusic.AI?

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ai-music-generator) is an AI music creation platform for turning text prompts, lyrics, and style direction into music drafts. If you need first lyrics or chorus revisions, the [AI Lyrics Generator](https://easymusic.ai/tools/ai-lyrics-generator) can help shape a draft, and the [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/tools/music-style-generator) can turn broad genre, mood, and instrument ideas into clearer style language. These tools help you make the draft; identity, rights review, distributor fields, and platform disclosure remain separate decisions.
## Separate Three Kinds of Identity

Before you upload, write three sentences. First: which person or team is responsible for the release? Second: what artist project name will listeners see? Third: does the profile present a real person, a stage name, a fictional project, or an AI persona with realistic-looking human imagery? That distinction matters. Some platforms now separate AI contribution credits inside a track from the public artist identity. Using AI in the music does not automatically make your profile an AI persona, and a fictional profile does not remove the need to describe AI contributions accurately.
## Map Contributions Instead of Saying AI Used

Make a short role map: lyrics, vocals, instrumental, production, cover art, video, captions. Next to each role, write human, AI-assisted, generated, edited, licensed, or not used. If your distributor does not yet show every field, keep the map in your release folder anyway. When a credits or disclosure prompt appears, you will answer from a record instead of from a foggy memory of the session.
## Do Not Borrow Someone Else's Identity

Check the prompt, lyrics, artist name, and cover before upload. Remove famous artist names, recognizable voice targets, look-alike portraits, near-copy logos, and bios that imply a relationship you do not have. A strong take should not depend on confusion. If you used a licensed vocal reference or a collaborator's material, keep the permission beside the release file rather than buried in a chat thread.
## Write the One-Page Brief

Use plain headings: public artist name, profile type, visual source, song role map, input permissions, final files, distributor questions, public note. The public note can be human and short, not defensive: for example, this track uses AI-assisted instrumentation with lyrics reviewed and edited by the writer. The goal is clarity. Inside EasyMusic.AI, save the final prompt and the version that produced your chosen files, then keep that tool record separate from the public artist biography.
## Reusable Ideas You Can Apply Today

- Choose the profile type before you commission or generate cover art.
- Mark the project privately as real person, stage name, fictional project, or AI persona.
- Save the final prompt, lyric draft, and rejection notes for takes that sounded too close to a known artist.
- Read the bio on a small phone screen as if you were a stranger.
- Keep AI contribution notes separate from the artist biography.
- Do not upload a large batch of tracks only because generation was easy.
## Review Before Upload

Ask: can a listener understand who is behind the project? Does any visual suggest a real person who does not exist? Do the credits say where AI helped with reasonable precision? Are samples, lyrics, voice inputs, and artwork materials permitted for the use you plan? Could the release run into platform rules around impersonation, misleading identity, or bulk uploads? If a serious answer is missing, delay the upload. A small pause is easier than a public correction after release.

## FAQ
### Is using AI to make music the same as being an AI persona?
No. AI persona usually refers to the public identity a profile presents, especially realistic human imagery for a person who does not exist. AI contribution in lyrics, vocals, instruments, or production is a separate record.
### Do I need to disclose AI use on every platform?
Rules vary. Keep accurate private notes either way, then follow the current upload questions from your distributor or platform.
### Can I use a fictional artist name?
Yes, but avoid making the project look like a real person if it is not, and avoid names or visuals that invite confusion with known artists.
### What if I am unsure about rights?
Do not write cleared in the notes. Collect permissions, check tool and platform terms, and get appropriate advice before a broad or commercial release.

es.title: Escribe un AI Song Release Identity Brief antes del upload
es.description: Workflow practico para separar artist identity, AI credits, lyrics, visuals y notas de distributor antes de un release asistido por IA.
body: La cancion esta casi lista. Tienes el master, una cover image, un nombre de proyecto que te gusta y tal vez un video corto. Entonces el formulario de upload hace las preguntas incomodas: quien es el artist, si la imagen representa a una persona real, que partes usaron AI y si la voz podria confundirse con alguien conocido. Si esperas hasta el dia del upload, puedes escribir respuestas apresuradas que hacen que el release parezca menos claro que la cancion.
## Que es EasyMusic.AI?

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/es/ai-music-generator) es una plataforma de creacion musical con IA para convertir text prompts, lyrics y direccion de estilo en music drafts. Si necesitas primeras lyrics o revisar un chorus, el [AI Lyrics Generator](https://easymusic.ai/es/tools/ai-lyrics-generator) puede ayudarte a formar un borrador, y el [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/es/tools/music-style-generator) convierte ideas amplias de genre, mood e instruments en lenguaje de estilo mas claro. Estas herramientas ayudan con el draft; identity, derechos, distributor fields y platform disclosure son decisiones aparte.
## Separa tres tipos de identidad

Antes del upload, escribe tres frases. Primera: que persona o equipo responde por el release. Segunda: que artist project name vera el publico. Tercera: si el profile presenta una persona real, un stage name, un proyecto ficticio o una AI persona con imagen humana realista. La distincion importa. Algunas plataformas ya separan AI contribution credits dentro del track de la public artist identity. Usar AI en la musica no convierte automaticamente el profile en AI persona.
## Mapea contribuciones, no escribas solo AI used

Haz un role map corto: lyrics, vocals, instrumental, production, cover art, video, captions. Junto a cada role escribe human, AI-assisted, generated, edited, licensed o not used. Si tu distributor aun no muestra todos esos campos, conserva la map dentro del release folder. Cuando aparezca una pregunta de credits o disclosure, responderas desde un registro y no desde una memoria borrosa.
## No tomes prestada la identidad de otra persona

Revisa prompt, lyrics, artist name y cover antes del upload. Elimina nombres de artistas famosos, objetivos de voz reconocible, retratos parecidos, logos casi copiados y bios que sugieran una relacion que no existe. Un buen take no debe depender de confusion. Si usaste una vocal reference licenciada o material de collaborator, guarda el permiso junto al release file.
## Escribe el brief de una pagina

Usa headings simples: public artist name, profile type, visual source, song role map, input permissions, final files, distributor questions, public note. La public note puede sonar humana y breve, no defensiva: por ejemplo, este track usa AI-assisted instrumentation con lyrics revisadas y editadas por la autora. El objetivo es claridad. Dentro de EasyMusic.AI, guarda el prompt final y la version que produjo tus archivos elegidos, pero manten ese registro separado de la artist biography publica.
## Ideas reutilizables para hoy

- Elige el profile type antes de encargar o generar cover art.
- Marca el proyecto en privado como real person, stage name, fictional project o AI persona.
- Guarda final prompt, lyric draft y notas de rechazo para takes demasiado cercanos a un artista conocido.
- Lee la bio en una pantalla pequena como si fueras un listener desconocido.
- Separa AI contribution notes de la artist biography.
- No subas un lote grande de tracks solo porque generarlos fue facil.
## Review antes del upload

Pregunta: un listener entiende quien esta detras del proyecto? Alguna visual sugiere una persona real que no existe? Los credits dicen con precision razonable donde ayudo AI? Samples, lyrics, voice inputs y artwork materials tienen permiso para el uso planeado? El release podria chocar con reglas de platform sobre impersonation, identidad enganosa o bulk uploads? Si falta una respuesta seria, retrasa el upload. Una pausa corta es mas facil que una correccion publica.

## FAQ
### Usar AI para crear musica es lo mismo que ser una AI persona?
No. AI persona suele referirse a la identidad publica del profile, sobre todo si muestra imagen humana realista de alguien que no existe. AI contribution en lyrics, vocals, instruments o production es otro registro.
### Debo divulgar AI en todas las plataformas?
Las reglas varian. Mantén notas privadas exactas y responde las preguntas actuales de tu distributor o platform.
### Puedo usar un artist name ficticio?
Si, pero evita hacerlo parecer una persona real si no lo es, y evita nombres o visuales que confundan con artistas conocidos.
### Que pasa si no se si tengo derechos suficientes?
No escribas cleared en las notas. Reune permisos, revisa terms de herramienta y plataforma, y busca asesoria apropiada antes de un release amplio o comercial.

fr.title: Ecris un AI Song Release Identity Brief avant l'upload
fr.description: Workflow pratique pour separer artist identity, AI credits, lyrics, visuals et notes de distributor avant une sortie assistee par IA.
body: Le morceau est presque pret. Tu as le master, une cover image, un nom de projet qui fonctionne, peut-etre une courte video. Puis le formulaire d'upload pose les questions moins confortables: qui est l'artist, l'image represente-t-elle une vraie personne, quelles parties ont utilise AI, et la voix peut-elle etre confondue avec quelqu'un de connu? Si tu attends le jour de l'upload, les reponses pressees peuvent rendre la sortie moins claire que le morceau.
## Qu'est-ce que EasyMusic.AI ?

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/fr/ai-music-generator) est une plateforme de creation musicale avec IA qui transforme text prompts, lyrics et direction de style en music drafts. Pour de premieres lyrics ou des revisions de chorus, le [AI Lyrics Generator](https://easymusic.ai/fr/tools/ai-lyrics-generator) aide a former un brouillon, et le [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/fr/tools/music-style-generator) rend les idees de genre, mood et instruments plus precises. Ces outils aident le draft; identity, droits, champs distributor et platform disclosure restent des decisions separees.
## Separe trois identites

Avant l'upload, ecris trois phrases. D'abord: quelle personne ou equipe porte la responsabilite du release? Ensuite: quel artist project name le public verra-t-il? Enfin: le profile presente-t-il une personne reelle, un stage name, un projet fictionnel ou une AI persona avec images humaines realistes? La nuance compte. Certaines plateformes separent maintenant les AI contribution credits dans le track de la public artist identity. Utiliser AI dans la musique ne transforme pas automatiquement le profile en AI persona.
## Cartographie les contributions au lieu d'ecrire AI used

Fais une role map courte: lyrics, vocals, instrumental, production, cover art, video, captions. Pour chaque role, note human, AI-assisted, generated, edited, licensed ou not used. Si ton distributor ne montre pas encore tous les champs, garde quand meme la map dans le release folder. Quand une question de credits ou disclosure apparaitra, tu repondras depuis un record clair.
## N'emprunte pas l'identite de quelqu'un d'autre

Relis prompt, lyrics, artist name et cover avant l'upload. Retire les noms d'artistes connus, les cibles vocales reconnaissables, les portraits ressemblants, les logos proches et les bios qui suggerent une relation inexistante. Un bon take ne devrait pas reposer sur la confusion. Si tu as utilise une vocal reference sous licence ou un materiel de collaborator, garde l'autorisation a cote du release file.
## Redige le brief d'une page

Utilise des headings simples: public artist name, profile type, visual source, song role map, input permissions, final files, distributor questions, public note. La public note peut etre courte et humaine, pas defensive: par exemple, ce track utilise AI-assisted instrumentation avec des lyrics relues et editees par l'auteur. Le but est la clarte. Dans EasyMusic.AI, conserve le prompt final et la version qui a produit les fichiers choisis, puis garde ce record separe de la artist biography publique.
## Idees reutilisables aujourd'hui

- Choisis le profile type avant de commander ou generer la cover art.
- Marque le projet en prive comme real person, stage name, fictional project ou AI persona.
- Garde final prompt, lyric draft et notes de rejet pour les takes trop proches d'un artiste connu.
- Lis la bio sur un petit ecran de telephone comme une personne qui decouvre le projet.
- Separe AI contribution notes et artist biography.
- Ne publie pas un gros lot de tracks seulement parce que la generation etait facile.
## Review avant l'upload

Demande-toi: un listener comprend-il qui se trouve derriere le projet? Un visual suggere-t-il une vraie personne qui n'existe pas? Les credits disent-ils avec une precision raisonnable ou AI a aide? Samples, lyrics, voice inputs et artwork materials sont-ils autorises pour l'usage prevu? Le release peut-il heurter des regles sur impersonation, identite trompeuse ou bulk uploads? Si une reponse importante manque, retarde l'upload. Une courte pause vaut mieux qu'une correction publique.

## FAQ
### Utiliser AI pour faire de la musique veut-il dire etre une AI persona?
Non. AI persona concerne plutot l'identite publique d'un profile, surtout avec une image humaine realiste d'une personne qui n'existe pas. Les apports AI dans lyrics, vocals, instruments ou production sont un autre record.
### Faut-il divulguer AI partout?
Les regles varient. Garde des notes exactes, puis reponds aux questions d'upload actuelles de ton distributor ou de ta plateforme.
### Puis-je utiliser un artist name fictif?
Oui, mais evite de le presenter comme une vraie personne si ce n'est pas le cas, et evite les noms ou visuals qui pretent a confusion avec des artistes connus.
### Que faire si les droits sont incertains?
N'ecris pas cleared. Rassemble les permissions, relis les terms et cherche un avis adapte avant une sortie large ou commerciale.

it.title: Scrivi un AI Song Release Identity Brief prima dell'upload
it.description: Workflow pratico per separare artist identity, AI credits, lyrics, visuals e note del distributor prima di un release assistito da IA.
body: Il brano e quasi pronto. Hai il master, una cover image, un nome di progetto che ti piace e forse un video breve. Poi il form di upload fa le domande scomode: chi e l'artist, l'immagine rappresenta una persona reale, quali parti hanno usato AI, e la voce potrebbe sembrare quella di qualcun altro? [EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/it/ai-music-generator) e una piattaforma di creazione musicale con IA per trasformare text prompts, lyrics e direzione di stile in music drafts. Se ti servono prime lyrics o revisioni del chorus, il [AI Lyrics Generator](https://easymusic.ai/it/tools/ai-lyrics-generator) puo aiutare a costruire un draft, e il [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/it/tools/music-style-generator) rende piu chiari genre, mood e instruments. Questi strumenti aiutano il draft; identity, diritti, distributor fields e platform disclosure restano decisioni separate.
## Separa tre identita

Prima dell'upload, scrivi tre frasi. Primo: quale persona o team e responsabile del release? Secondo: quale artist project name vedra il pubblico? Terzo: il profile presenta una persona reale, uno stage name, un progetto fiction o una AI persona con immagini umane realistiche? La distinzione conta. Alcune piattaforme separano gia gli AI contribution credits dentro il track dalla public artist identity. Usare AI nella musica non rende automaticamente il profile una AI persona.
## Mappa i contributi invece di scrivere AI used

Crea una role map breve: lyrics, vocals, instrumental, production, cover art, video, captions. Accanto a ogni role scrivi human, AI-assisted, generated, edited, licensed o not used. Se il distributor non mostra ancora tutti i campi, tieni comunque la map nel release folder. Quando compare una domanda di credits o disclosure, risponderai da un record chiaro invece che dalla memoria della sessione.
## Non prendere in prestito l'identita altrui

Controlla prompt, lyrics, artist name e cover prima dell'upload. Rimuovi nomi di artisti famosi, obiettivi vocali riconoscibili, look-alike portraits, loghi troppo vicini e bio che suggeriscono una relazione inesistente. Un buon take non deve dipendere dalla confusione. Se hai usato una vocal reference con licenza o materiale di un collaborator, salva il permesso accanto al release file.
## Scrivi il brief di una pagina

Usa headings semplici: public artist name, profile type, visual source, song role map, input permissions, final files, distributor questions, public note. La public note puo essere breve e umana, non difensiva: per esempio, questo track usa AI-assisted instrumentation con lyrics revisionate ed editate dall'autore. L'obiettivo e chiarezza. In EasyMusic.AI, salva il prompt finale e la version da cui arrivano i file scelti, poi tieni quel record separato dalla artist biography pubblica.
## Idee riutilizzabili oggi

- Scegli il profile type prima di commissionare o generare cover art.
- Segna il progetto in privato come real person, stage name, fictional project o AI persona.
- Salva final prompt, lyric draft e note di rifiuto per takes troppo vicini a un artista noto.
- Leggi la bio su un piccolo schermo come se fossi un listener sconosciuto.
- Separa AI contribution notes dalla artist biography.
- Non caricare un grande lotto di tracks solo perche generarli e stato facile.
## Review prima dell'upload

Chiedi: un listener capisce chi c'e dietro il progetto? Un visual suggerisce una persona reale che non esiste? I credits dicono con precisione ragionevole dove AI ha aiutato? Samples, lyrics, voice inputs e artwork materials sono permessi per l'uso previsto? Il release potrebbe urtare regole su impersonation, identita ingannevole o bulk uploads? Se manca una risposta seria, rimanda l'upload. Una breve pausa e meglio di una correzione pubblica.

## FAQ
### Usare AI per fare musica significa essere una AI persona?
No. AI persona riguarda di solito l'identita pubblica del profile, specialmente immagini umane realistiche per una persona che non esiste. AI contribution in lyrics, vocals, instruments o production e un record separato.
### Devo dichiarare AI su ogni piattaforma?
Le regole cambiano. Tieni note private accurate e rispondi alle domande attuali del tuo distributor o platform.
### Posso usare un artist name fittizio?
Si, ma evita di farlo sembrare una persona reale se non lo e, ed evita nomi o visuals che confondono con artisti conosciuti.
### E se non sono sicuro dei diritti?
Non scrivere cleared nelle note. Raccogli permissions, controlla terms e chiedi consiglio adatto prima di una pubblicazione ampia o commerciale.

ja.title: Upload 前に AI Song Release Identity Brief を書く
ja.description: AI-assisted release の前に artist identity、AI credits、lyrics、visuals、distributor notes を分けるための実用 workflow。
body: Song はほぼ完成しています。Master、cover image、気に入った project name、短い video もあるかもしれません。そこで upload form が少し難しい質問をします。Artist は誰か、image は real person を表すのか、どの parts に AI を使ったのか、voice は誰かと間違われないか。Upload day まで待つと、song より release の説明が曖昧になります。
## EasyMusic.AI とは？

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ja/ai-music-generator) は text prompts、lyrics、style direction から music drafts を作る AI music creation platform です。First lyrics や chorus revision が必要なら [AI Lyrics Generator](https://easymusic.ai/ja/tools/ai-lyrics-generator) が draft 作りを助け、[Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/ja/tools/music-style-generator) は genre、mood、instruments の広い idea をより明確な style language にします。Draft 作成には役立ちますが、identity、rights review、distributor fields、platform disclosure は別の decision です。
## 三つの identity を分ける

Upload 前に三つの sentence を書きます。第一に、release に責任を持つ person または team は誰か。第二に、listeners が見る artist project name は何か。第三に、profile は real person、stage name、fictional project、または realistic human imagery を使う AI persona なのか。この distinction は大切です。一部 platform は track 内の AI contribution credits と public artist identity を分けて扱います。Music に AI を使っただけで profile が AI persona になるわけではありません。
## AI used ではなく contribution を map する

短い role map を作ります: lyrics, vocals, instrumental, production, cover art, video, captions。各 role の横に human, AI-assisted, generated, edited, licensed, not used と書きます。Distributor がすべての field を表示しなくても、map は release folder に残します。Credits や disclosure の質問が出た時、session の曖昧な memory ではなく record から答えられます。
## 他人の identity を借りない

Upload 前に prompt、lyrics、artist name、cover を確認します。有名 artist name、recognizable voice target、look-alike portrait、似すぎた logo、存在しない関係を示す bio は削ります。Strong take でも confusion に頼るべきではありません。Licensed vocal reference や collaborator material を使ったなら、permission を chat thread ではなく release file の横に保存します。
## 一ページの brief を書く

Heading は簡単で十分です: public artist name, profile type, visual source, song role map, input permissions, final files, distributor questions, public note。Public note は defensive ではなく短く人間らしくします。例: この track は AI-assisted instrumentation を使い、lyrics は writer が review と edit をした。目的は clarity です。EasyMusic.AI では final prompt と chosen files を生んだ version を保存し、その tool record を public artist biography とは分けておきます。
## 今日すぐ使える ideas

- Cover art を依頼または生成する前に profile type を決める。
- Project を privately real person, stage name, fictional project, AI persona のどれかで記録する。
- Known artist に近すぎた takes の final prompt、lyric draft、rejection notes を残す。
- Bio を小さな phone screen で stranger として読む。
- AI contribution notes と artist biography を分ける。
- 生成が簡単だっただけで大量の tracks を upload しない。
## Upload 前の review

確認します。Listener は project の背後に誰がいるか理解できますか。Visual は存在しない real person を示していませんか。Credits は AI が助けた場所を reasonable precision で示していますか。Samples、lyrics、voice inputs、artwork materials は予定する use に使えますか。Release は impersonation、misleading identity、bulk uploads に関する platform rules と衝突しませんか。大事な答えがないなら upload を遅らせます。短い pause は公開後の correction より楽です。

## FAQ
### AI で music を作ることは AI persona と同じですか？
いいえ。AI persona は通常、profile が示す public identity、特に存在しない realistic human imagery に関係します。Lyrics、vocals、instruments、production の AI contribution は別の record です。
### すべての platform で AI use を disclose すべきですか？
Rules は違います。正確な private notes を保ち、distributor または platform の current upload questions に従います。
### Fictional artist name は使えますか？
使えます。ただし real person のように見せたり、known artists と混同される names や visuals は避けます。
### Rights が不明な場合は？
Notes に cleared と書かないでください。Permissions を集め、tool と platform の terms を確認し、広い公開や commercial release の前に適切な advice を得ます。

ko.title: Upload 전에 AI Song Release Identity Brief를 쓰세요
ko.description: AI-assisted release 전에 artist identity, AI credits, lyrics, visuals, distributor notes를 분리하는 실용 workflow.
body: Song은 거의 준비됐습니다. Master, cover image, 마음에 드는 project name, 짧은 video까지 있을 수 있습니다. 그런데 upload form이 까다로운 질문을 던집니다. Artist는 누구인가, image가 real person을 나타내는가, 어떤 parts에 AI를 썼는가, voice가 다른 사람으로 오해될 수 있는가. Upload day까지 기다리면 song보다 release 설명이 더 흐려질 수 있습니다.
## EasyMusic.AI란?

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ko/ai-music-generator)는 text prompts, lyrics, style direction을 music drafts로 만드는 AI music creation platform입니다. First lyrics나 chorus revision이 필요하면 [AI Lyrics Generator](https://easymusic.ai/ko/tools/ai-lyrics-generator)가 draft를 잡는 데 도움을 주고, [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/ko/tools/music-style-generator)는 genre, mood, instruments 같은 넓은 idea를 더 clear한 style language로 바꿉니다. 이 tools는 draft 제작을 돕지만 identity, rights review, distributor fields, platform disclosure는 별도 decision입니다.
## 세 가지 identity를 분리한다

Upload 전에 세 sentence를 씁니다. 첫째, release에 책임지는 person 또는 team은 누구인가. 둘째, listeners가 볼 artist project name은 무엇인가. 셋째, profile은 real person, stage name, fictional project, 또는 realistic human imagery를 쓰는 AI persona인가. 이 distinction은 중요합니다. 일부 platform은 track 안의 AI contribution credits와 public artist identity를 분리합니다. Music에 AI를 썼다고 profile이 자동으로 AI persona가 되는 것은 아닙니다.
## AI used 대신 contribution을 map한다

짧은 role map을 만듭니다: lyrics, vocals, instrumental, production, cover art, video, captions. 각 role 옆에 human, AI-assisted, generated, edited, licensed, not used를 씁니다. Distributor가 아직 모든 field를 보여주지 않아도 map을 release folder에 둡니다. Credits나 disclosure prompt가 나오면 session의 흐린 기억이 아니라 record에서 답할 수 있습니다.
## 다른 사람의 identity를 빌리지 않는다

Upload 전에 prompt, lyrics, artist name, cover를 확인합니다. Famous artist names, recognizable voice targets, look-alike portraits, near-copy logos, 없는 관계를 암시하는 bios를 제거하세요. 좋은 take라도 confusion에 기대면 안 됩니다. Licensed vocal reference나 collaborator material을 썼다면 permission을 chat thread 안이 아니라 release file 옆에 보관합니다.
## 한 페이지 brief를 쓴다

Headings는 simple하게 둡니다: public artist name, profile type, visual source, song role map, input permissions, final files, distributor questions, public note. Public note는 defensive하지 않고 짧고 human하게 씁니다. 예: 이 track은 AI-assisted instrumentation을 사용했고 lyrics는 writer가 review 및 edit했다. Goal은 clarity입니다. EasyMusic.AI에서는 final prompt와 chosen files를 만든 version을 저장하고, 그 tool record를 public artist biography와 분리합니다.
## 오늘 바로 적용할 수 있는 ideas

- Cover art를 의뢰하거나 생성하기 전에 profile type을 정합니다.
- Project를 private record에 real person, stage name, fictional project, AI persona 중 하나로 표시합니다.
- Known artist와 너무 가까웠던 takes의 final prompt, lyric draft, rejection notes를 남깁니다.
- Bio를 small phone screen에서 stranger처럼 읽어봅니다.
- AI contribution notes와 artist biography를 분리합니다.
- 생성이 쉬웠다는 이유만으로 large batch tracks를 upload하지 않습니다.
## Upload 전 review

물어보세요. Listener가 project 뒤에 누가 있는지 이해하나요? Visual이 존재하지 않는 real person을 암시하나요? Credits가 AI가 도운 지점을 reasonable precision으로 말하나요? Samples, lyrics, voice inputs, artwork materials는 계획한 use에 허용되나요? Release가 impersonation, misleading identity, bulk uploads에 관한 platform rules와 충돌할 수 있나요? 중요한 답이 없다면 upload를 늦추세요. 짧은 pause가 release 후 public correction보다 쉽습니다.

## FAQ
### AI로 music을 만들면 AI persona인가요?
아닙니다. AI persona는 보통 profile이 제시하는 public identity, 특히 존재하지 않는 realistic human imagery와 관련됩니다. Lyrics, vocals, instruments, production의 AI contribution은 별도 record입니다.
### 모든 platform에서 AI use를 disclose해야 하나요?
Rules는 다릅니다. 정확한 private notes를 보관하고 distributor 또는 platform의 current upload questions에 답하세요.
### Fictional artist name을 써도 되나요?
가능합니다. 다만 real person처럼 보이게 하거나 known artists와 혼동되는 names나 visuals는 피하세요.
### Rights가 불확실하면요?
Notes에 cleared라고 쓰지 마세요. Permissions를 모으고 tool 및 platform terms를 확인한 뒤 broad 또는 commercial release 전에 적절한 advice를 받으세요.

pt.title: Escreva um AI Song Release Identity Brief antes do upload
pt.description: Workflow pratico para separar artist identity, AI credits, lyrics, visuals e notas de distributor antes de um release assistido por IA.
body: A musica esta quase pronta. Voce tem o master, uma cover image, um nome de projeto que gosta e talvez um video curto. Entao o formulario de upload faz as perguntas desconfortaveis: quem e o artist, a imagem representa uma pessoa real, quais partes usaram AI e a voz pode ser confundida com alguem conhecido? Se voce espera ate o dia do upload, pode escrever respostas apressadas que deixam o release menos claro que a musica.
## O que e EasyMusic.AI?

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/pt/ai-music-generator) e uma plataforma de criacao musical com IA para transformar text prompts, lyrics e direcao de estilo em music drafts. Se precisa de primeiras lyrics ou revisoes de chorus, o [AI Lyrics Generator](https://easymusic.ai/pt/tools/ai-lyrics-generator) ajuda a formar um draft, e o [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/pt/tools/music-style-generator) transforma ideias amplas de genre, mood e instruments em linguagem de estilo mais clara. Essas ferramentas ajudam o draft; identity, direitos, distributor fields e platform disclosure continuam decisoes separadas.
## Separe tres tipos de identidade

Antes do upload, escreva tres frases. Primeiro: qual pessoa ou equipe e responsavel pelo release? Segundo: qual artist project name o publico vera? Terceiro: o profile apresenta uma pessoa real, um stage name, um projeto ficticio ou uma AI persona com imagem humana realista? Essa distincao importa. Algumas plataformas ja separam AI contribution credits dentro do track da public artist identity. Usar AI na musica nao torna automaticamente o profile uma AI persona.
## Mapeie contribuicoes em vez de escrever AI used

Faca uma role map curta: lyrics, vocals, instrumental, production, cover art, video, captions. Ao lado de cada role escreva human, AI-assisted, generated, edited, licensed ou not used. Se o distributor ainda nao mostra todos os campos, mantenha a map no release folder. Quando aparecer uma pergunta de credits ou disclosure, voce respondera a partir de um record claro, nao de memoria vaga.
## Nao pegue emprestada a identidade de outra pessoa

Verifique prompt, lyrics, artist name e cover antes do upload. Remova nomes de artistas famosos, alvos de voz reconhecivel, retratos parecidos, logos quase copiados e bios que sugerem uma relacao inexistente. Um bom take nao deve depender de confusao. Se usou uma vocal reference licenciada ou material de collaborator, guarde a permissao ao lado do release file.
## Escreva o brief de uma pagina

Use headings simples: public artist name, profile type, visual source, song role map, input permissions, final files, distributor questions, public note. A public note pode ser curta e humana, nao defensiva: por exemplo, este track usa AI-assisted instrumentation com lyrics revisadas e editadas pela autora. O objetivo e clareza. No EasyMusic.AI, salve o prompt final e a versao que produziu seus arquivos escolhidos, depois mantenha esse tool record separado da artist biography publica.
## Ideias reutilizaveis para hoje

- Escolha o profile type antes de encomendar ou gerar cover art.
- Marque o projeto em privado como real person, stage name, fictional project ou AI persona.
- Salve final prompt, lyric draft e notas de rejeicao para takes proximos demais de um artista conhecido.
- Leia a bio em tela pequena como se fosse um listener desconhecido.
- Separe AI contribution notes da artist biography.
- Nao faca upload de um lote grande de tracks so porque a geracao foi facil.
## Review antes do upload

Pergunte: um listener entende quem esta por tras do projeto? Algum visual sugere uma pessoa real que nao existe? Os credits dizem com precisao razoavel onde AI ajudou? Samples, lyrics, voice inputs e artwork materials sao permitidos para o uso planejado? O release pode bater em regras de platform sobre impersonation, identidade enganosa ou bulk uploads? Se uma resposta importante falta, adie o upload. Uma pausa curta e mais facil que uma correcao publica.

## FAQ
### Usar AI para fazer musica e o mesmo que ser uma AI persona?
Nao. AI persona normalmente se refere a public identity do profile, especialmente imagem humana realista de uma pessoa que nao existe. AI contribution em lyrics, vocals, instruments ou production e um record separado.
### Preciso divulgar AI em toda plataforma?
As regras variam. Mantenha notas privadas precisas e responda as perguntas atuais do seu distributor ou platform.
### Posso usar um artist name ficticio?
Sim, mas evite fazer o projeto parecer uma pessoa real se nao for, e evite nomes ou visuals que confundam com artistas conhecidos.
### E se eu nao tiver certeza sobre direitos?
Nao escreva cleared nas notas. Reuna permissions, confira terms da ferramenta e da plataforma, e busque aconselhamento adequado antes de um release amplo ou comercial.

ru.title: Напишите AI Song Release Identity Brief до upload
ru.description: Практический workflow, который отделяет artist identity, AI credits, lyrics, visuals и distributor notes перед AI-assisted release.
body: Песня почти готова. Есть master, cover image, удачное имя проекта и, возможно, короткое video. Затем upload form задает неудобные вопросы: кто artist, изображение показывает реального человека, какие parts использовали AI, может ли voice быть принят за кого-то другого? Если ждать дня upload, ответы будут спешными, и release может выглядеть менее ясным, чем сама песня.
## Что такое EasyMusic.AI?

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ru/ai-music-generator) - это AI music creation platform для превращения text prompts, lyrics и style direction в music drafts. Если нужны первые lyrics или revision для chorus, [AI Lyrics Generator](https://easymusic.ai/ru/tools/ai-lyrics-generator) помогает собрать draft, а [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/ru/tools/music-style-generator) превращает широкие идеи genre, mood и instruments в более ясный style language. Эти tools помогают сделать draft; identity, rights review, distributor fields и platform disclosure остаются отдельными решениями.
## Разделите три вида identity

Перед upload напишите три предложения. Первое: какой person или team отвечает за release? Второе: какой artist project name увидят listeners? Третье: profile представляет real person, stage name, fictional project или AI persona с realistic human imagery? Это важное различие. Некоторые platforms уже разделяют AI contribution credits внутри track и public artist identity. Использование AI в музыке не делает profile автоматически AI persona.
## Сделайте карту вкладов вместо AI used

Создайте короткую role map: lyrics, vocals, instrumental, production, cover art, video, captions. Рядом с каждой role напишите human, AI-assisted, generated, edited, licensed или not used. Если distributor пока не показывает все поля, все равно сохраните map в release folder. Когда появится вопрос о credits или disclosure, вы ответите из ясного record, а не из мутной памяти о session.
## Не занимайте чужую identity

Проверьте prompt, lyrics, artist name и cover до upload. Уберите имена известных artists, recognizable voice targets, look-alike portraits, почти скопированные logos и bios, которые намекают на несуществующую связь. Сильный take не должен держаться на confusion. Если использовался licensed vocal reference или material collaborator, сохраните permission рядом с release file.
## Напишите brief на одну страницу

Используйте простые headings: public artist name, profile type, visual source, song role map, input permissions, final files, distributor questions, public note. Public note может быть короткой и человеческой, не защитной: например, этот track использует AI-assisted instrumentation, а lyrics проверены и отредактированы автором. Цель - clarity. В EasyMusic.AI сохраните final prompt и version, которая дала выбранные files, затем держите этот tool record отдельно от public artist biography.
## Идеи, которые можно применить сегодня

- Выберите profile type до заказа или генерации cover art.
- Отметьте project приватно как real person, stage name, fictional project или AI persona.
- Сохраните final prompt, lyric draft и rejection notes для takes, слишком похожих на известного artist.
- Прочитайте bio на маленьком экране телефона как незнакомый listener.
- Отделите AI contribution notes от artist biography.
- Не загружайте большой batch tracks только потому, что generation была легкой.
## Review перед upload

Спросите: понимает ли listener, кто стоит за project? Намекает ли visual на real person, которого не существует? Говорят ли credits с разумной точностью, где помог AI? Samples, lyrics, voice inputs и artwork materials разрешены для нужного use? Может ли release столкнуться с platform rules про impersonation, misleading identity или bulk uploads? Если важного ответа нет, отложите upload. Короткая pause проще публичного correction после release.

## FAQ
### Использование AI для музыки означает AI persona?
Нет. AI persona обычно относится к public identity profile, особенно realistic human imagery для человека, которого не существует. AI contribution в lyrics, vocals, instruments или production - отдельный record.
### Нужно ли раскрывать AI на каждой platform?
Rules различаются. Ведите точные private notes и отвечайте на текущие upload questions distributor или platform.
### Можно ли использовать fictional artist name?
Да, но не делайте project похожим на real person, если это не так, и избегайте names или visuals, похожих на известных artists.
### Что если rights не ясны?
Не пишите cleared в notes. Соберите permissions, проверьте tool и platform terms и получите подходящий advice перед широким или commercial release.

zh.title: Upload 前先写 AI Song Release Identity Brief
zh.description: 一个实用 workflow：在 AI-assisted release 前分清 artist identity、AI credits、lyrics、visuals 和 distributor notes。
body: Song 已经差不多完成了。你有 master、cover image、喜欢的 project name，也许还有一段 short video。然后 upload form 开始问更麻烦的问题：artist 是谁，image 是否代表 real person，哪些 parts 用了 AI，voice 会不会被误认为别人。如果等到 upload day 才回答，release 的说明可能比 song 本身更混乱。
## EasyMusic.AI 是什么？

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/zh/ai-music-generator) 是一个 AI music creation platform，可以把 text prompts、lyrics 和 style direction 变成 music drafts。如果需要 first lyrics 或 chorus revision，[AI Lyrics Generator](https://easymusic.ai/zh/tools/ai-lyrics-generator) 可以帮助形成 draft，[Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/zh/tools/music-style-generator) 可以把 genre、mood、instruments 这类宽泛 idea 变成更清楚的 style language。这些 tools 帮你做 draft；identity、rights review、distributor fields 和 platform disclosure 仍然是单独的 decisions。
## 分清三种 identity

Upload 前写三句话。第一，哪个 person 或 team 对 release 负责？第二，listeners 会看到哪个 artist project name？第三，profile 展示的是 real person、stage name、fictional project，还是带有 realistic human imagery 的 AI persona？这个 distinction 很重要。一些 platforms 已经把 track 内的 AI contribution credits 和 public artist identity 分开处理。Music 使用 AI 不会自动让 profile 变成 AI persona。
## 不要只写 AI used，要做 contribution map

做一张短 role map：lyrics、vocals、instrumental、production、cover art、video、captions。每个 role 后面写 human、AI-assisted、generated、edited、licensed 或 not used。就算 distributor 还没有显示所有 fields，也把 map 放进 release folder。等 credits 或 disclosure prompt 出现时，你可以根据 record 回答，而不是靠模糊记忆。
## 不要借用别人的 identity

Upload 前检查 prompt、lyrics、artist name 和 cover。去掉 famous artist names、recognizable voice targets、look-alike portraits、near-copy logos，以及暗示不存在关系的 bios。一个 strong take 不应该依赖 confusion。如果使用了 licensed vocal reference 或 collaborator material，把 permission 存在 release file 旁边，而不是埋在 chat thread 里。
## 写一页 brief

Headings 保持简单：public artist name、profile type、visual source、song role map、input permissions、final files、distributor questions、public note。Public note 可以短而自然，不需要像辩护词：例如，这首 track 使用 AI-assisted instrumentation，lyrics 由 writer review 和 edit。目标是 clarity。在 EasyMusic.AI 里保存 final prompt 和生成 chosen files 的 version，然后把这个 tool record 与 public artist biography 分开。
## 今天就能用的 ideas

- 在委托或生成 cover art 前先确定 profile type。
- 私下把 project 标记为 real person、stage name、fictional project 或 AI persona。
- 保存 final prompt、lyric draft，以及拒绝过于接近 known artist 的 takes 的 notes。
- 在小手机屏幕上像陌生 listener 一样阅读 bio。
- 把 AI contribution notes 和 artist biography 分开。
- 不要因为 generation 很容易就 upload 大批 tracks。
## Upload 前 review

问自己：listener 能理解 project 背后是谁吗？Visual 是否暗示一个不存在的 real person？Credits 是否以合理精度说明 AI 帮助了哪里？Samples、lyrics、voice inputs 和 artwork materials 是否允许用于计划中的 use？Release 是否可能触碰 impersonation、misleading identity 或 bulk uploads 相关 platform rules？如果重要答案缺失，就延后 upload。短暂停下来比 release 后公开 correction 更轻松。

## FAQ
### 用 AI 做 music 就等于 AI persona 吗？
不是。AI persona 通常指 profile 呈现的 public identity，尤其是用 realistic human imagery 表示一个不存在的人。Lyrics、vocals、instruments 或 production 中的 AI contribution 是另一份 record。
### 每个平台都必须 disclose AI use 吗？
Rules 会变化。无论如何先保存准确的 private notes，然后按照当前 distributor 或 platform 的 upload questions 回答。
### 可以使用 fictional artist name 吗？
可以，但不要把 project 做得像真实存在的人，也避免容易让人联想到 known artists 的 names 或 visuals。
### 如果 rights 不确定怎么办？
不要在 notes 里写 cleared。先收集 permissions，检查 tool 和 platform terms，并在 broad 或 commercial release 前获得合适 advice。
